_note: Labelled evaluation sets for jarvis/tool_select.py and jarvis/intent_judge.py. The tool catalogue is the real built-in tools plus synthetic MCP tools (the same schemas an MCP server would advertise).

mcp_tools.name: homeassistant.get_state
mcp_tools.description: Get the current state of a smart home device or entity such as a light, thermostat or sensor

mcp_tools.name: homeassistant.turn_on
mcp_tools.description: Turn on a smart home light, switch or device

mcp_tools.name: homeassistant.turn_off
mcp_tools.description: Turn off a smart home light, switch or device

mcp_tools.name: github.create_issue
mcp_tools.description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository

mcp_tools.name: github.list_pull_requests
mcp_tools.description: List open pull requests of a GitHub repository

mcp_tools.name: calendar.list_events
mcp_tools.description: List upcoming calendar events and meetings for a date range

mcp_tools.name: calendar.create_event
mcp_tools.description: Create a calendar event or meeting at a given time

mcp_tools.name: mail.send_message
mcp_tools.description: Send an email message to a recipient

mcp_tools.name: mail.search_inbox
mcp_tools.description: Search the email inbox for messages

mcp_tools.name: notes.create_note
mcp_tools.description: Save a new note with a title and text

mcp_tools.name: weather.get_forecast
mcp_tools.description: Get the weather forecast for a city

mcp_tools.name: music.play
mcp_tools.description: Play a song, album or playlist

mcp_tools.name: tasks.add_task
mcp_tools.description: Add a to-do task to the task list

mcp_tools.name: database.run_query
mcp_tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query against the database
